skills.name: Divine Arrow (一矢)
skills.line: I can see a crack in your armor!
skills.description:
Miketsu attacks a single target dealing damage equal to 80% of her ATK.
After an enemy takes an action, she has 5% chance of releasing an Arrow of Sealing at them, dealing damage equal to 100% of her ATK and has a 100% base chance of inflicting each of the following effects for 1 turn; Silence, Suppress, Seal, and 75% of Heal Down. Arrow of Sealing will not trigger the target's souls or passive.

skills.name: Fox Realm (狐狩界/狐狩り結界)
skills.description:
Miketsu forms a Fox Realm that lasts for 1 turn. While the realm is open, the chance of her releasing Arrow of Sealing is increased to 40% and grants her 4 layers of Amulet, max 12 layers.
